patients.summary: 51-year-old teacher with type 2 diabetes, hypothyroidism, obesity and chronic constipation who joined in 2020. Gallstones failed ursodiol dissolution, plantar fasciitis and overactive bladder settled with conservative care, rectal prolapse was repaired by rectopexy in 2024, and obstructive jaundice from a bile duct stone in December 2025 led to ERCP and cholecystectomy.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
New patient, 45F, transferring from a prior internal medicine office. Here to establish.

Problems she brings:
1. T2DM, dx around 2016 by prior PCP. Metformin 1000 BID since then, tolerating. Doesn't check sugars at home. Last A1c she remembers was "under 7." No known eye/kidney/nerve issues. Eye exam overdue.
2. Hypothyroid since ~2009, levothyroxine 100 mcg, same dose for years. Takes it first thing.
3. Weight. Has been in the low 180s for about 10 yrs. Tries to cut carbs, on and off.
4. Constipation for as long as she can remember, goes every 2-3 days, strains. Manages with prunes, water, salad. No blood, no weight loss.
Also takes a multivitamin and OTC ibuprofen 1-2 tabs now and then for aches after a long day standing.

PSH: none. No abdominal or pelvic surgery.
OB: G3P3, three vaginal deliveries, youngest is 14.
FH: mother T2DM and "her bladder dropped" (pelvic organ prolapse). Maternal grandmother hypothyroid. Father had gallstones.
SH: 3rd grade teacher, before that worked retail sales for years. Married, 3 kids. Never smoker. No alcohol at all.
Allergies: NKDA.

ROS: negative except as above. No polyuria/polydipsia. No numbness in feet. No chest pain or SOB.

Exam: vitals per flowsheet. BMI ~31. Pleasant, well appearing. Thyroid not enlarged, no nodules. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abd soft, obese, nontender, no organomegaly. Feet: skin intact, monofilament intact both feet, DP pulses 2+. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, cervix normal, Pap/HPV collected. No visible prolapse.

A/P
- T2DM: continue metformin. A1c, CMP, lipids, urine microalbumin today. Optometry referral list given for dilated exam.
- Hypothyroid: TSH.
- Obesity: talked portion size, walking after school. She'd rather do it on her own for now.
- Constipation: fiber/fluids, she's comfortable with her routine.
- HM: Pap/HPV today. Tdap today (no record of one). HCV and HIV screens. Mammogram ordered. Colon screening at 45 - discussed, she'd like to wait until next year.
- Records requested from prior office.
Return ~6 months, sooner prn. She has my cell.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Shannon, your labs are back and look good. A1c is in the target range, kidney function and thyroid are normal, and your HIV and hepatitis C screens are negative. Cholesterol is borderline, nothing to change today and we'll keep an eye on it. Pap result will come separately in a few days.

documents.title: RE: Your lab results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Thank you! That's a relief. I made the mammogram appointment for November.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Received 41 pages from her prior internal medicine office covering 2014-2020. Summary for the chart: T2DM diagnosed spring 2016 after fasting glucose and A1c in diabetic range, metformin started then and titrated to 1000 mg BID by fall 2016. Hypothyroidism on levothyroxine, at 100 mcg since at least 2014 with TSH normal on each check. A1c values 2017-2020 between 6.5 and 7.0. Pap 2017 normal. No colonoscopy or mammogram on file within the last 2 years. Immunizations: influenza most years. Allergies: none recorded. Filed to media.

documents.title: Diabetes Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
6 mo DM check. Teaching hybrid this year, says it's been exhausting. Taking metformin regularly, no GI upset. Levothyroxine daily. Didn't make the eye appointment yet.
Got first Pfizer appointment next week through the school district.
Exam: BP and weight as charted, weight unchanged. Heart/lungs normal. Feet without lesions.
A/P: T2DM - A1c today, BMP. No change. Gave optometry number again.
Hypothyroid - stable, TSH next physical.
Colon screening - she wants to think about FIT vs colonoscopy, will decide at physical.
F/u September for physical.

documents.title: A1c result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c stable, still at goal. Kidney function and potassium normal. Keep doing what you're doing.

documents.title: Diabetic eye examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body:
Diabetic Eye Examination Report
Date of exam: 06/03/2021
Patient: Shannon Pomeroy
Dilated fundus exam OU. VA cc 20/20 OD, 20/25 OS. IOP 15/16. Lens clear OU. Disc margins sharp, C/D 0.3 OU. Macula flat, no edema. No microaneurysms, hemorrhages or exudates.
Impression: no diabetic retinopathy. Glasses Rx updated.
Recommend: repeat dilated exam in 12 months.
Allergies: NKDA.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. 46F. Back in the classroom full time, glad. Feels fine.
DM: metformin 1000 BID, no lows, no symptoms. Eye exam done in June, no retinopathy.
Thyroid: levo 100, no symptoms.
Bowels: same pattern, every couple days.
Weight: about the same.
Meds reviewed: metformin, levothyroxine, MVI, ibuprofen prn.
Exam: well appearing. HEENT normal. Neck no thyromegaly. CV regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abd soft NT. Breasts: no masses, no axillary nodes. Feet: monofilament normal bilat, pulses intact, no calluses. Skin no concerning lesions.
PHQ-2 0.
A/P
- T2DM: labs today incl A1c, UACR, lipids.
- Hypothyroid: TSH.
- CRC screen: chose FIT, kit given and returned at checkout.
- Mammogram due Nov 2022 (biennial ok, she prefers every 1-2 yrs).
- Flu in Oct. Booster when eligible.
Next DM visit March.

documents.title: Physical labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: All reviewed. A1c in range, kidneys/urine protein normal, TSH normal, FIT negative. LDL about the same as last year. Next FIT in a year unless we switch to colonoscopy.
